description: PROP-H3 (required:true) acceptance demands 'multi-match resolves to the HIGHEST-PRIORITY issue per REQ-H3 priority order' — i.e. the SYSTEM picks one issue when multiple match. The production code only exposes classify_issue_from_snapshot which returns a LIST of all detected issues. There is no production function that, given that list, applies PRIORITY_ORDER and returns the single highest-priority Issue. test_multi_match_resolves_to_highest_priority simulates this resolution INSIDE the test (it calls max(issues, key=lambda...) by hand). The dispatch correctness gate is therefore tested at test-fixture level, not at the production API level. Any real caller that iterates issues in detection-order rather than priority-order would dispatch the wrong fix; the static type contract doesn't prevent it.
